description: Platform-wide LARGE executed trades on Polymarket, across every market at once, newest first, filtered by a minimum cash size (price x shares in USD). Use for "trades of $50k or more on Polymarket today", "biggest fills in the last 24 hours", "whale trades right now". Each fill: market title, market slug, event slug, condition id, side (BUY/SELL), outcome, size (shares), price, usd_value (size x price), unix, timestamp, transaction hash, and the trader's wallet, display name and pseudonym exactly as the publisher shows them (no enrichment). Pass min_usd (required) and optionally window_start / window_end (ISO datetime or epoch seconds; the publisher has no time filter, so the tool walks the tape back itself and `coverage` states whether it reached window_start or ran out of page budget). DISTINCT from polymarket_trades (one market's tape, any size). Source: Polymarket, trades tape.

max_pages.description: Page budget, 1-10 (default 5, 1000 fills each). If the walk stops before window_start, coverage.complete is false.

min_usd.description: Minimum cash size of a fill in USD (size x price), e.g. 50000. Must be > 0.

window_end.description: ISO datetime or epoch seconds, exclusive (default: now). Only used with window_start.

window_start.description: ISO datetime or epoch seconds, inclusive. Omit for the newest fills with no time bound.

name: polymarket_large_trades
title: Polymarket Large Trades
